PM Modi mourns death of Dubai ruler Sheikh Ahmed bin Rashid Al Maktoum

Prime Minister Narendra Modi has expressed his condolences on the passing of Sheikh Ahmed bin Rashid Al Maktoum. Dubai has declared a 10-day mourning period following his death. UAE rulers and Crown Princes offered condolences to Sheikh Mohammed.
